'''Fussball-Club Luzern''', commonly abbreviated to '''FC Luzern''' ({{IPA|de|ɛf ˈt͡seː luˈtsɛrn}}) or simply '''FCL''', is a Swiss [[sports club]] based in [[Lucerne]] ({{langx|de|Luzern}}). They are best known for their men's professional [[association football|football]] team, which plays in the [[Swiss Super League|Super League]], the top tier of the [[Football in Switzerland|Swiss football league system]], and has won the [[List of Swiss football champions|national title]] once and the [[Swiss Cup|national cup]] three times.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sfl.ch/de/meistertafel|title=Meistertafel|publisher=[[Swiss Football League]]|access-date=12 August 2016|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.schweizercup.ch/schweizer-cup/geschichte.aspx |title=Schweizer Cup - Geschichte & Statistik|publisher=[[Swiss Football Association]] |access-date=12 August 2026 |language=de}}</ref>

The club's women's team are competing in the [[Swiss Women's Super League]].

The club colours are blue and white, reflecting the colours of the coats of arms of the City of Lucerne and the [[Canton of Lucerne]]. The club plays its home matches at the new [[Thermoplan Arena|Stadion Allmend]], which was built in 2011 on the site of the [[Stadion Allmend|former stadium]].<ref>{{cite web|title=FCL - Stadion|url=https://fcl.ch/club/stadion|access-date=12 August 2026|language=de}}</ref>

FC Luzern was founded in 1901. It has non-professional departments for [[association football|football]], [[volleyball]], [[boccia]] and [[gymnastics]].<ref>{{cite web|title=FC Luzern – Sektionen|url=https://www.fcl-verein.ch/|access-date=12 August 2026|language=de}}</ref>"}}
